reviews.title: It is only efficient for people who are in Public School
reviews.text: Hello, I am in online school and since there isn’t a “bell” and I don’t have a bell schedule, I’m unable to use the app to its fullest potential. As the app doesn’t register anything else besides a “bell schedule”. You have the schools, even the online schools. Yet push “bell schedules” for everyone. We only use Google Meet, Buzz, Gmail, Google, Xello, Calendar, and a few other sites for our school. I can only upload my Google Meet Schedule, which is my personal schedule. It is very frustrating, especially when you have friends that live 30-45 minutes away and you want to keep a schedule so you can make plans or keep in touch with them with more ease. I hope this doesn’t come off too abrasive. Thanks!

reviews.title: Dangerous for Minors
reviews.text: Saturn’s high-school public mode can expose a minor’s full recurring class schedule to other users in the school community—effectively revealing predictable whereabouts. Yet the college experience requires mutual friendship before calendars are visible. Why should high-schoolers get weaker schedule privacy than adults? This is an unacceptable privacy design for a student app. The decision to give high-schoolers weaker protections raises serious questions about the developers’ judgment and intentions.

reviews.title: Promising School Scheduling app with flaws
reviews.text:
The concept of this app is pretty promising, I actually really like it but it’s also relatively buggy and frustrating to use sometimes. Like for instance it can be slow a lot of the time when it comes to loading to view your friends’ classmates with the UI being a little weird, like you can view a profile and accidentally hit send a friend request without even knowing. 

Some other stuff I’d like to point out is that the 3 Minute Notification for when a class ends is extremely delayed, like it will display when there’s only 1 minute or a few seconds remaining of the class. I also don’t like how you have to constantly touch the app in order to have the Timer Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, it should just be done automatically when you open the app once. I think you should also be able to see friends’ classmates if they allow it with a setting.

Changing schedules is also a hell because sometimes it doesn’t even want to process it, giving the weirdest errors ever sometimes it’s not even valid. You have to constantly click on the schedule you made or create a new variant just for it to apply. It’s not fun. The app would be a lot better if all these changes were fixed because they are annoying and the app would be more convenient if they were tweaked.

Edit: My review has been changed as I’m now dissatisfied with the app, you guys went too overboard with privacy features that now you can’t even tell who’s in your class, essentially it’s useless now.

I tried submitting a photo but reaching out to an agent just doesn’t work. I’ve been waiting 2 to 3 days. Literally nobody has tried helping me. I tried to communicate by describing my schedule. Literally nothing. The AI says that they can’t do anything and now is redirecting me to my actual phone’s calendar so my problem is the AI sucks and doesn’t work. My other problem is there’s no way to really reach out for help. Another bad thing is that there’s no other way to really fix it. The app becomes useless. This is really disappointing because there’s also no other way to report an issue. This is why I’m leaving this review cause there’s no way I can report any issues or even reach out to a real human being agent this app sucks. Don’t download it if you have a unique schedule.
